intro: San Diego listings advertise non-climate 10x10 units from about $39. City street rates run about $174–$178/month, while the metro asking rent is about $220; the advertised rate in the table is the average of those sources. Rates are down a few percent year over year, but the six-month average still clears the promo by a wide margin. On StorageCafe's size table a climate-controlled 10x10 ($172) is a hair under the non-climate city average, so check the unit rather than assuming climate control costs more here.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Climate-controlled street rate ~$80.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$109.

Most rented size. City average $174, down 3.3% YoY (StorageCafe, Sep 2026); StorageUnitCosts lists $178 for August 2026, down 2.2% YoY, about 48% above the national average. San Diego metro averages $220, down 3.1% YoY (Storage Stats), higher than the city figure because the metro includes pricier suburbs. Climate-controlled city street rate ~$172.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$241.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Climate-controlled ~$318.

local_tips: Location drives price: StorageCafe lists Lincoln Park (~$153), Fairmont Park (~$162) and Palm City (~$162) among the cheapest areas, while Bernardo Springs (~$349) and Carmel Mountain (~$316) run highest.

Nearby 10x10 street rates (StorageCafe, Sep 2026) run from about $132 in Spring Valley and $148 in La Mesa up to about $201 in Encinitas. That spread is why the metro average sits above the city figure.
San Diego rates tend to be lowest around January and highest in August (StorageCafe).

The city added about 91,000 sq ft in 2025, roughly 1.4% of inventory, and has about 4.1 sq ft per capita (StorageCafe) — tighter than the Texas markets, which is why street rates stay high even as they ease.
Extra Space charges a $50 admin fee (per StorageUnitCosts), higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
